meta.name: competitive-research-snapshot
meta.description: Research a competitive landscape with cited snapshots, a comparison matrix, and so-what implications. Use when a product decision needs competitive grounding, not a market report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成竞品对比矩阵与行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要快速了解竞品格局
copy.tagline_en: Generate competitive comparison matrix and actionable insights quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick competitive grounding before product decisions

howto.what: 按固定流程做竞争研究:先出搜索计划,再选3~4个对手,只收集够用的信息,每个结论标注事实/推断/假设并附上来源链接,最后输出包含范围、对手快照、对比矩阵和“所以呢”含义的快照。
howto.when: 当产品决策需要竞争依据(而非市场报告)时触发;若未提供公司或决策,会先问最多3个问题再继续。

say.text: 帮我做竞争快照:我们的费用自动化产品,决策是下季度主攻哪个功能。
say.note: 会输出带引用和比较矩阵的快照。

say.text: 研究一下我们的三大竞争对手,重点看强弱项,用于定位决策。
对我们和对手〔A〕做竞争快照,支持涨价决策。
say.note: 会询问未提供的竞争对手等。

howto.what_en: Runs a fixed-format competitive research: shows a search plan, selects 3–4 competitors, gathers just enough info, labels every claim Fact/Inference/Assumption with URL citations, and emits a snapshot with scope, competitor snapshots, comparison matrix, and so-what implications.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a product decision needs competitive grounding, not a market report; if company or decision is missing, it asks up to 3 questions first.

say_en.text: Research our top 3 competitors, focusing on strengths and weaknesses, for positioning decisions.
Run a competitive snapshot on us vs. competitor [A] to support a pricing decision.
